title: ChatGPT for Accounting with Campfire
summary: Campfire is now in ChatGPT for Accounting. Ask about your books in plain language and click any number to see its source in Campfire.
body_markdown:
Campfire is proud to be part of the launch of ChatGPT for Accounting with OpenAI. Starting today, finance teams can install the Campfire plugin in ChatGPT and ask questions about their books in plain language. Answers come straight from your Campfire ledger, and every number links back to the record it came from.


Month-end questions rarely need a new report. They need a fast, trustworthy answer: how did October compare to September, which customers are furthest behind on payment, where did cash go last month. With Campfire in ChatGPT, you ask, review the answer, and click through to Campfire when you want to see the detail.


## Install Campfire in ChatGPT


Setup takes three clicks. In ChatGPT, open **Plugins** , search for **Campfire** , and select **Install plugin** . Sign in with your Campfire account to connect your company workspace.


The plugin page shows example prompts to try first, so you can see what Campfire can answer before you type your own question.


## Ask about your books in plain language


Start your message with **Campfire** and ask the way you would ask someone on your team. A few prompts to start with:


- Compare revenue, expenses, and net income for the last two completed months.
- Show my five largest overdue customer invoices, including the balance and days overdue.
- Summarize last month's cash flow by operating, investing, and financing activities.


Campfire pulls the numbers from your ledger and ChatGPT lays them out for review. Ask for a month-over-month comparison and you get a table of revenue, expenses, and net income with the change for each, plus a short note on what drove it. Ask a follow-up, like breaking out the expense lines or drafting a variance memo, and the conversation keeps going from there.


## Click through to the source in Campfire


Every answer links back to Campfire. Select **Open in Campfire** next to any line and the matching report opens in your workspace, with the full line items behind the total.


That means you can check a number before you put it in a board deck or send it to your CFO. ChatGPT gets you the answer quickly. Campfire stays the system of record.


## Your controls stay in place


The plugin works inside the rules you already set in Campfire:


- **Permissions:** each person sees and does only what their Campfire role allows.
- **Approvals and closed periods:** approval requirements and closed-period controls apply to any change, the same as in Campfire.
- **Audit history:** every call the plugin makes is recorded in your connection audit history.


The plugin connects through Campfire's OAuth apps platform, so your admin decides who can connect and can see every connection in one place.


## Get started


Install the Campfire plugin in ChatGPT today:[chatgpt.com/plugins/accounting](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/accounting) . Already a Campfire customer? Ask your admin to approve the connection, then try the comparison prompt above on your last two closed months.
